title: Survey Shows Top-Down Pressure to Adopt Generative AI, But Just 30% of Enterprises are Ready to Do So Today
summary: Executives at large enterprises across the globe are facing unprecedented pressures around adopting GenAI, addressing ever-increasing data complexity, and managing a growing skills gap.
